name: sol_defi_as_11
description: Missing minimum output amount check before AMM token swap, enabling sandwich/slippage attacks
question: The source file in `source` executes a token swap on an AMM (e.g. calling a router's swap/exchange function) without first computing or enforcing a minAmountOut (or equivalent slippage bound) derived from a trustworthy, manipulation-resistant price source, so an attacker can sandwich the transaction and force it to execute at an unfavorable rate; this excludes swaps that pass a nonzero minAmountOut/minOut parameter computed from a reliable off-chain quote or TWAP oracle with reasonable tolerance, and excludes trusted admin-only rebalancing functions explicitly documented as safe from front-running.
criteria: Calls router.swapExactTokensForTokens or similar with amountOutMin hardcoded to 0
Computes minAmountOut using the pool's own spot price (e.g. getAmountsOut from the same pool) right before the swap call
Passes no slippage/minOut parameter at all to the swap function, allowing any output amount
Derives minAmountOut from a manipulable on-chain reserve ratio without a TWAP or external oracle safeguard
